title: MissionLab scenario, missionlab-plan/1 and missionlab-plan/2
description: A scenario for MissionLab, an unofficial mod toolkit for OPERATOR. missionlab-plan/1 holds the scenario at the root. missionlab-plan/2 holds the same body under "mission" (without its own schema key); it is written only when a zone or hold trigger has a shaped area, so that older versions refuse the file instead of reading the shape as a circle. The plugin (ScenarioFile.cs) and the editor read files strictly by these rules, and also check what a schema cannot say: trigger and place numbers are unique, every link points at a trigger that exists, and every area is a sound shape. Keys that are not listed are ignored.
